order_lines_exactly_one_catalog_item.name: order_lines_exactly_one_catalog_item
order_lines_exactly_one_catalog_item.value: ("order_lines"."line_type" = 'PRODUCT' and "order_lines"."product_id" is not null and "order_lines"."service_id" is null) or ("order_lines"."line_type" = 'SERVICE' and "order_lines"."service_id" is not null and "order_lines"."product_id" is null)

orders_void_requires_timestamp_and_reaso.name: orders_void_requires_timestamp_and_reason
orders_void_requires_timestamp_and_reaso.value: "orders"."status" <> 'VOID' or ("orders"."voided_at" is not null and "orders"."void_reason" is not null and length(btrim("orders"."void_reason")) > 0)

stock_ledger_override_requires_reason.name: stock_ledger_override_requires_reason
stock_ledger_override_requires_reason.value: "stock_ledger"."override" = false or ("stock_ledger"."reason" is not null and length(btrim("stock_ledger"."reason")) > 0)
